Priya: Hey finance — heads up: vendor BlueOak Labs flagged their April invoice. They had a promo trial that ended 2026-04-10 but were billed full-month minimum. Can someone confirm if we should prorate and issue a manual credit?
Sam: Do we have the invoice id and the billed amount?
Priya: Invoice #INV-2026-0429-BO, total charged $4,000. They say trial covered 10 days, so they expect ~1/3 off (~$1,333). They attached the trial agreement.
Luis: Upload the invoice PDF to the billing ticket and paste the trial start/end dates here. I'll check usage vs. plan.
Priya: Uploaded to ticket BI-7123. Trial: 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-10 (inclusive). Post-trial usage started 2026-04-11.
Sam: Quick calc: 30-day month, trial 10 days -> chargeable 20/30 = 0.6667 of monthly min. So prorated amount should be $4,000 * 20/30 = $2,666.67. Credit needed = $4,000 - $2,666.67 = $1,333.33.
Olivia: That matches vendor ask. Any contractual gotchas? Did we already apply a promo credit elsewhere?
FinanceBot: Automation check: No historical promo credits found for BlueOak Labs (acct BO-998). No previous manual adjustments in the last 12 months.
Luis: Good. This is within manual credit approval (< $5k). I recommend issuing a goodwill prorate credit for $1,333.33 and note "trial overlap — proration".
Sam: I can create the credit memo. @Olivia do you sign off on the wording and amount?
Olivia: Approved. Add note: do not change their contract tier; this is a one-time goodwill proration.
Sam: Creating credit now...
Sam: Done — created credit CR-19384 for $1,333.33 against INV-2026-0429-BO. Applied to outstanding balance. Billing ticket BI-7123 updated with credit id and journal entry.
Priya: Thanks team — forwarding confirmation to BlueOak. Please set reminder to verify next invoice shows correct tier and no duplicate credits.
FinanceBot: Reminder set on BI-7123 for 2026-05-05 to verify next invoice. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Perfect. Closing this thread. :thumbsup:
